description: Professional account, transaction, statement, verification, lending, fraud, complaint, and service emails for financial institutions.
placeholder_format: Use double-brace variables, for example {{customer_name}}. Replace every placeholder before sending.

templates.name: Account Opening Confirmation
templates.trigger: After an account opening application is approved and the account is created
templates.subject: Your Account Has Been Successfully Created

templates.name: Transaction Alert
templates.trigger: After a debit or credit transaction is recorded
templates.subject: Transaction Alert – {{transaction_reference}}

templates.name: Monthly Account Statement
templates.trigger: When a monthly statement is generated
templates.subject: Your Monthly Account Statement Is Available

templates.name: New Login Alert
templates.trigger: After a login event that meets the institution’s alert rules
templates.subject: Security Alert: New Login to Your Banking Account

templates.name: KYC Update Reminder
templates.trigger: When an authorised account review identifies an outstanding verification requirement
templates.subject: Action Required: Review Your Account Verification
templates.body:
Dear {{customer_name}},

Our records indicate that an account verification update may be required. Please review any outstanding requirements through the official {{bank_name}} application or website.

Open the official verification portal: {{official_verification_url}}

For your security, do not send identity documents or sensitive banking information by replying to this email. If you have already completed the process, please disregard this reminder.

Regards,
Customer Verification Team
{{bank_name}}

templates.name: Card Dispatch Notification
templates.trigger: When a payment card is dispatched
templates.subject: Your Banking Card Has Been Dispatched

templates.name: Loan Application Update
templates.trigger: When a loan application status changes
templates.subject: Update on Your Loan Application – {{application_id}}

templates.name: Suspicious Activity Alert
templates.trigger: When monitoring systems flag activity requiring customer review
templates.subject: Important Security Notice Regarding Your Account
templates.body:
Dear {{customer_name}},

We detected activity that requires your attention. To help protect your account, review your recent activity using the official {{bank_name}} application or website.

Do not share your one-time password, PIN, password, or card details with anyone. Do not use links in unexpected messages to access your account.

For urgent assistance, contact the fraud prevention team using the number published on {{official_website}}.

Regards,
Fraud Prevention Team
{{bank_name}}

templates.name: Complaint Acknowledgement
templates.trigger: When a customer complaint is registered
templates.subject: We Have Received Your Complaint – {{complaint_id}}

templates.name: Banking Service Update
templates.trigger: When a service, fee, process, or operating arrangement changes
templates.subject: Important Service Update – {{bank_name}}
